lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Lip fold base|lip, ~90.6 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the label point on the outer-arc apex: nearest point 0.19-0.33 mm, outer-arc maximum within -0.04/+0.12 mm. The outer-arc band runs t=-2.3..373.3 against a 0..373.3 line, with no gaps. Lip and base are straight in the wide sections, so it is a single fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Tall flange 3/4 at the +y end, ~90.4 deg. Sections show two clean concentric arcs and the label sits on the outer apex (0.01-0.24 mm). The fold's arc runs t=0..44.7 and the line runs 0..45.3. The collinear arc band at t<-58 belongs to the separate 65 deg tab fold B5, a different plate.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Inclined tall flange 5/6 at the -y end, ~110 deg bend. The label is on the outer-arc apex at all three stations (0.09-0.59 mm from the nearest point, at most 0.11 mm in v). The arc runs t=0..44.5 and the line 0..43.4. The wide section shows one straight inclined flange with no second kink. Strips 15/16/18/19 are bend-radius facets.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Short tab 9/10 at the -y end, ~90 deg. The label is on the outer-arc apex (0.00-0.37 mm). The arc runs t=-1.2..47 (the relief notch is at about 48) and the line 0..47.4. The band beyond t=104 is the separate 110 deg B3 fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Short inclined tab 11/12 at the +y end, ~65.5 deg. The label is on the outer-arc apex at 25/50/75% (0.13-0.21 mm). The arc runs t=-1.7..47.0 and the line 0..46.9. The base next to this tab sags gradually: local slope falls steadily from about 9 deg at 4 mm to about 1 deg by 15 mm, with no second corner or flat facet. That is bend-zone run-out (a gentle rolled kink), not a separate bend of 10 deg or more.
